victory.trigger: confirmed successful settlement once, not on predicted last move
victory.input: result buttons active immediately when safe; never wait for particles to expire
victory.spawn: result panel upper corners, not on numerical stats
victory.tint: runtime existing palette optional; neutral white base
victory.motion: downward curved drift, small rotational variation, no full-screen opaque flash
victory.overdraw: cap count, stop offscreen, no unbounded emission

energy_return.trigger: only after authoritative settlement commits actual clamped energy delta
energy_return.logical_delta: min(5,30-old_energy) under existing reward rules; visual must not award or write a second time
energy_return.visual_count: min(actual_delta,5); no link between particle arrivals and awarding
energy_return.source: result panel upper-center anchor, not fixed screen sample position
energy_return.destination: shared live energy icon center, same HUD on every page
energy_return.position_curve: quadratic Bezier, start -> upward midpoint -> live HUD anchor
energy_return.counter: render authoritative state, optional visual count-up without data mutation
energy_return.navigation: cancel visuals safely if page changes; never lose committed reward

reduced_motion.replace: brief local icon opacity pulse max200ms, no camera shake
